findings.reviewed_v2: Wrong beta requires exact Invalid(mode exponent tuple). Omission errors must be Integrity(unattached bipartite port); duplicate errors must be Integrity(bipartite port ordering). Unexpected errors panic; each mutant must refuse at least one group. Groups unaffected by the mutation may correctly return Ok.

A separate valid-packing call uses a fresh vector=0 Meter,requires actual Error::Limit,and explicitly requires false for both coverage classifications. Group0 has retained endpoint ports,so it is nonempty; a vector guard rejects no later than its first child edge. This is a planned source-backed negative control,not an observed result.

implementation_fidelity.graph_binding: Each returned child is validated by its constructor. The control compares selected old vertex order,Arc identity,arity and retained creation precision3; new packet creation precision equals working ring precision7. Sorted full incidence triples include retained vertex,original port and packet identity,so parallel endpoints remain distinct.
implementation_fidelity.mass: Every group child is constructed for each tested fixed tuple; group edge counts equal endpoint counts,full sum equals2M,and common-precision weighted sum equals2M*7. Old vertices and isolates partition once; packet vertices total radix*packet_count. Histograms are compared across selected beta states.
implementation_fidelity.early_stop_limit: The control deliberately constructs the full group family. Production evaluate_at may stop at a zero product or earlier error; only a visited nonnegative prefix bound<=2M follows there. This source control does not measure actual traversal or prove its total cost.
